(TRIVALENT)"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"TOLERANCE NOTE :- (English) 1) ALL H7 HOLES C.D SHOULD BE CONTROLLED WITHIN +/- 0.02. / IT7"}],"comment":"The part is zinc plated (I.Z.B.P.) and note N1 calls out H7 holes, which are tight-fit bores, but no allowance is made for the plating thickness on those holes. The plating will build up inside the holes and can cause mating pins or shafts to not fit; the designer must either specify that the H7 tolerance applies after plating or enlarge the pre-plate hole size to compensate.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that H7 hole tolerances apply after plating, or increase the machined hole diameter by twice the maximum plating thickness so the finished holes meet H7."}]}
